encodeHamming74.result: seven-character word; position1 leftmost, parity1/2/4, data3/5/6/7

result.checks: three objects in parity1,2,4 order: parityPosition, positions (array), bits (string), ones (integer), failed (boolean)
result.candidateWord: received word after optional proposed single flip

arguments: flippedPositions: dense array of unique integers1..7, length0..7
prediction: null or integer0..7; omitted defaults null

truth.remainingDataErrors: Hamming distance candidate/original four data bits
truth.outcome: clean if0; corrected if1; undetected if>1 and zero syndrome; miscorrected if>1 and nonzero syndrome

formatHammingRecord.result: deterministic UTF-8 text; recounts supplied dataBits/errorPositions/prediction through runHamming74; carries convention, actual parity arithmetic, decoder-only inference, separately labeled simulation truth, optional prediction, and limitations

invariants: No input mutation; structured results and nested arrays are frozen.
Invalid strings, non-array/sparse/duplicate/out-of-range positions and invalid predictions throw before any result; no coercion or automatic trimming.
inspectReceived74 receives no original data or flip mask.
No input/output filesystem, randomness, channel probability, authentication or network in this module.
